defect: an active-high synchronized reset is consumed with active-low polarity
rationale: rst_i asserts reset_sync_q high, but value_o resets on the falling edge of reset_sync_q[1], so reset assertion and release are interpreted backwards.
author: gpt-5.6-luna

provenance.adaptation: Reduced the active-high reset synchronizer to two stages and one functional consumer.

mutation.description: Changed the functional consumer from active-high reset to an active-low edge and condition.

labels.by: claude-sonnet (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: Active-low reset taken from a chain that is 1 during reset and falls after release, asserting reset after rst_i deasserts.
